question: Find the full name and average points in Turkish Grand Prix races of the driver born in 1985 who recorded the fastest single lap time (in milliseconds) in any Turkish Grand Prix.

prediction.sql:
WITH fastest_lap_driver AS (
    SELECT d.XCL_034 AS driver_id
    FROM drivers d
    JOIN lapTimes lt ON d.XCL_034 = lt.XCL_044
    JOIN races r ON lt.XCL_043 = r.XCL_065
    WHERE d.XCL_040 LIKE '1985%'
      AND r.XCL_069 = 'Turkish Grand Prix'
    ORDER BY lt.XCL_048 ASC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT d.XCL_038 || ' ' || d.XCL_039 AS full_name
FROM drivers d
JOIN fastest_lap_driver fld ON d.XCL_034 = fld.driver_id

roles.description: Lap time recorded in the first qualifying session (Q1). This is the most frequently populated time column, serving as the baseline for all qualifying entries.

Lap time recorded in the third qualifying session (Q3). This column is populated only for drivers who advanced from Q2, exhibiting a strict subset relationship with Q2 times.

structural_constraints.description: Participation in the second qualifying session (Q2) implies participation in the first qualifying session (Q1). The data confirms this: every row with a Q2 time has a Q1 time, but many rows with a Q1 time do not have a Q2 time.

Participation in the third qualifying session (Q3) implies participation in the second qualifying session (Q2). The data confirms this: every row with a Q3 time has a Q2 time, but many rows with a Q2 time do not have a Q3 time.

WITH fastest_lap_driver AS (
    SELECT d.XCL_034 AS driver_id
    FROM drivers d
    JOIN lapTimes lt ON d.XCL_034 = lt.XCL_044
    JOIN races r ON lt.XCL_043 = r.XCL_065
    WHERE d.XCL_040 LIKE '1985%'
      AND r.XCL_069 = 'Turkish Grand Prix'
    ORDER BY lt.XCL_048 ASC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT d.XCL_038 || ' ' || d.XCL_039 AS full_name
FROM drivers d
JOIN fastest_lap_driver fld ON d.XCL_034 = fld.driver_id

entity_grain_realization.pre_realization_sql:
WITH fastest_lap_driver AS (
    SELECT d.XCL_034 AS driver_id
    FROM drivers d
    JOIN lapTimes lt ON d.XCL_034 = lt.XCL_044
    JOIN races r ON lt.XCL_043 = r.XCL_065
    WHERE d.XCL_040 LIKE '1985%'
      AND r.XCL_069 = 'Turkish Grand Prix'
    ORDER BY lt.XCL_048 ASC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT d.XCL_038 || ' ' || d.XCL_039 AS full_name
FROM drivers d
JOIN fastest_lap_driver fld ON d.XCL_034 = fld.driver_id

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT 
    d.XCL_037 || ' ' || d.XCL_038 AS full_name,
    AVG(r.XCL_082) AS average_points
FROM drivers d
JOIN results r ON d.XCL_034 = r.XCL_075
JOIN races ra ON r.XCL_074 = ra.XCL_065
WHERE d.XCL_036 = 1985
  AND ra.XCL_069 = 'Turkish Grand Prix'
  AND d.XCL_034 = (
      SELECT lt.XCL_044
      FROM lapTimes lt
      JOIN races ra2 ON lt.XCL_043 = ra2.XCL_065
      WHERE ra2.XCL_069 = 'Turkish Grand Prix'
        AND lt.XCL_047 IS NOT NULL
      ORDER BY CAST(SUBSTR(lt.XCL_047, 1, INSTR(lt.XCL_047, '.') - 1) AS INTEGER) * 1000 + CAST(SUBSTR(lt.XCL_047, INSTR(lt.XCL_047, '.') + 1) AS INTEGER)
      LIMIT 1
  )
GROUP BY d.XCL_034
